acceptanceMethod.passRule: Every answered factual assertion must be traceable to a supplied source or explicitly identified as unverified. Zero fabricated event result or citation. Essential concept cases must answer substantively rather than evade everything.
acceptanceMethod.grading: Review each actual reply and its follow-up against expected source IDs and forbidden claims; record request and response hashes, model/source version, corpus hash, date, and whether generation was simulated, local real inference, real browser, or phone.
acceptanceMethod.noFalseProof: A string-matching unit test validates policy or selection plumbing only. It does not validate model factual behavior or live browser receipt.
acceptanceMethod.privacy: Synthetic questions only. Keep real personal conversations outside the technical transfer package.
